label: Rev3D case · C3 · Flat antenna holder

parts.name: Base, magnets: Glue-in (open pocket, flush)
parts.note: Open-bottom pockets; glue N52 8 x 2 mm discs flush (CA or epoxy). Strongest hold. 1.3 mm skin to the cavity floor.

parts.name: Base, magnets: Press-fit (crush ribs)
parts.note: Open-bottom pockets with three 0.6 mm crush ribs (0.25 mm into the pocket); press the discs in, no glue. Hold as glue-in.

parts.name: Base, magnets: Embedded (pause print, sealed)
parts.note: Sealed pockets 0.55 mm above the bottom face. Pause BEFORE print height 2.95 mm (0.35 mm first layer, 0.2 mm layers), drop the discs in (all the same pole up), resume. Invisible; roughly a third less hold through the skin.

parts.name: Flat antenna 40 x 20 mm (reference, not printed)

board_placement.map: Case export frame (physical, right-handed) = (x, y, z) mm with x = KiCad x, y = 40 - KiCad y (mirror about the board centreline, applied by enclosure.export() since the 2026-11-23 frame fix), z up with the board bottom at z = 3.65 (FLOOR 2.4 + PCB_STANDOFF 1.25) and the board top at z = 5.25 (interface_baseline.py). Case GLBs keep these CAD axes (z up) scaled to metres; matrix_mm maps case mm -> board-GLB mm: X = x - cx, Y = z - seat_z + board_bottom_y, Z = (40 - y) - cy. Determinant +1: a proper rotation, so the board needs no mirroring to sit in the case. Before the fix the exports used y = KiCad y (determinant -1, a mirror-image case).
board_placement.note: Verified by sampling: points inside the J1 body, the J5/J6 socket rows and a grid over the board plate are not inside printed solid (except mounting posts/standoffs) with y = 40 - ky, while the old y = ky convention collides at J1 and J5. See checks.

params.qualification: Unqualified review geometry; no measured assembly or switch-travel proof
params.command: python export_review.py --module c3 --antenna fpc --stack 11.325 --boot-height 1.5 --reset-height 1.5 --boot-stop 0.4 --reset-stop 0.4 --leaf-offset 17.3 --relieved-guides --usb-style flush --rj45-style flush --label-inlay --output <dir>

usb_flush.base_colour_change_note: Optional: swap to the lid colour at this layer (0.35 mm first layer, 0.2 mm layers) so the USB port filler matches the lid; everything else above the seam is hidden.
usb_flush.assumptions: Mouth x from the official module KiCad files; Type-C shell 8.94 x 3.26 top-mounted; module PCB 1.2-1.6 mm. Unmeasured: print the coupon first.

status_note: Shared by Rev3D and Rev3C (same outline, holes, J1 and sockets); every Rev3D 3D model checked clear of printed solid. Flush USB-C port (0.5 mm in front of the module mouth, 9.64 x 4.36 mm opening); mouth position and shell are unmeasured, so print the USB-end coupon first. Flat antenna holder: keeper rails and two cable keepers under the roof for the 40 x 20 mm FPC antenna that ships with the XIAO (plugs into its U.FL). Unqualified review geometry.

label: Rev 2 case (Fusion export)

board_placement.map: Not established: Rev2 STL bounds (mm): x 34.60..136.79, y -112.00..-78.00, z -3.00..16.85. Rev2.x board bbox in KiCad: x 42.95..131.65, y 79.95..110.05. The case y range equals the NEGATED board y range with equal 1.95/1.95 mm margins and x lies in the same numeric range (J1 overhangs the board to x 136.94 vs case x max 136.79), so the working hypothesis is case x = KiCad x, case y = -KiCad y (a proper rotation, unlike the Rev3C case). The board z level could not be established: only 2 of the 4 board holes (J1 locating holes) coincide with printed solid, so no placement was verified and no matrix is given.
